entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:1
segments: ¶To everything there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heavens:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:2
segments: A time to be born, and a time to die; A time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:3
segments: A time to kill, and a time to heal; A time to break down, and a time to build up;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:4
segments: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; A time to mourn, and a time to dance;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:5
segments: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; A time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:6
segments: A time to seek, and a time to lose; A time to keep, and a time to cast away;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:7
segments: A time to rend, and a time to sew; A time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:8
segments: A time to love, and a time to hate; A time of war, and a time of peace.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:9
segments: What profit hath he that worketh from that wherein he laboureth?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:10
segments: I have seen the travail that God hath given to the sons of men to toil in.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:11
segments: ¶He hath made everything beautiful in its time; also he hath set the world in their heart, so that man findeth not out from the beginning to the end the work that God doeth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:12
segments: I know that there is nothing good for them but to rejoice and to do well in their life;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:13
segments: yea also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labour, it is the gift of God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:14
segments: I know that whatever God doeth, it shall be for ever; there is nothing to be added to it, nor anything to be taken from it; and God doeth [it], that [men] should fear before him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:15
segments: That which is was long ago, and that which is to be hath already been; and God bringeth back again that which is past.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:16
segments: ¶And moreover I saw under the sun, that in the place of judgment, wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, wickedness was there.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:17
segments: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:18
segments: I said in my heart, It is thus with the children of men, that God may prove them, and that they should see that they themselves are but beasts.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:19
segments: For what befalleth the children of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other, and they have all one breath; and man hath no pre-eminence above the beast: for all is vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:20
segments: All go unto one place: all are of the dust, and all return to dust.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:21
segments: Who knoweth the spirit of the children of men? Doth it go upwards? and the spirit of the beasts, doth it go downwards to the earth?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:22
segments: And I have seen that there is nothing better than that man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion; for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
